note: AI-assisted findings from the litigated-case corpus. Operator-approved by merge. Each is one number and its consequence; the live EVIDENCE page recomputes the underlying data continuously.

findings.title: Your biggest insider threat is the one you can't investigate
findings.stat_label: of role-known insider cases were executives or officers — 230 of 320, the largest class by an order of magnitude
findings.takeaway: The biggest actor class is the one an insider-threat program reports to. You can't investigate the person who signs your paycheck, so these cases don't get caught internally — they surface in court.
recommendations: Set escalation triggers by behavior, not rank — before there's a case.
Route officer-level cases around the executive chain: audit committee or outside counsel.
Watch the public record — Form 4 timing, insider-transaction filings, statements vs. internal reports.
Treat SEC-whistleblower channels as part of the system, not a failure of it.
findings.method: AI-assisted analysis of litigated cases. Court data is a filtered sample — mostly securities suits, which over-represent executives — and that skew is the point, not noise. Roles are model-extracted, not hand-audited; magnitudes are directional.
